title: Development Intern
description:
**Company Description**
Invenex is a digital solutions company that has grown from a website development firm into a comprehensive growth partner for businesses. The company serves clients of all sizes across Asia and the Middle East, delivering custom mobility solutions, web and mobile applications, and dynamic digital marketing strategies. Invenex’s multidisciplinary team of developers, designers, and marketing professionals collaborates with industry leaders to redesign and power their digital marketplaces. The company focuses on building long-term partnerships through services such as e-commerce development and social media marketing. Invenex is committed to helping organizations unlock their potential and co-create sustainable growth stories.
  
**Role Description**
The Development Intern role is a full-time, on-site position based in Thrissur. The intern will assist in software development and programming tasks, including writing, testing, and debugging code under the guidance of senior developers. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with the development team on web and mobile projects, analyzing requirements, and contributing to technical documentation. The intern may support basic configuration, troubleshooting, and integration activities, as well as coordinate with cross-functional teams such as design and marketing to ensure project alignment. The role offers exposure to client-focused solutions and opportunities to learn modern development practices in a fast-paced environment.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to understand requirements, interpret data, and solve technical problems.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with team members and convey technical information clearly.
* Candidates should possess Software Development skills, including familiarity with development lifecycles, frameworks, and tools.
* Candidates should possess Programming skills in at least one modern language (such as JavaScript, Python, Java, or similar).
* Candidates should possess basic Sales awareness to understand client needs and support solution-oriented discussions when required.
* Relevant qualifications include current enrollment in or recent completion of a degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Additional beneficial skills include familiarity with web and mobile technologies, version control systems (e.g., Git), and a willingness to learn new tools and frameworks.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment, manage time effectively, and adapt to changing project priorities is highly valued.
